defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) (Administration guides) and the Meteor design system documentation, retrieved 2026-08-20. Shopware 6.7 administration: Vue 3, Pinia, Vite.

components.title: Shopware Administration components
components.description: Shopware admin components: creating and overriding components, modules, menu entries, routing, data grids, directives, mixins, filters. Use when building a Shopware administration module or component.
components.intro: The Vue layer. A module registers routes and menu entries; components are registered globally and overridden by name.

data.title: Shopware Administration data handling
data.description: Shopware admin data: repositoryFactory and Criteria in JS, API requests, Pinia and Vuex stores, services, error handling, ACL. Use when loading or saving data in the Shopware administration.
data.intro: Data comes through repositoryFactory, not fetch. Pinia is current, Vuex is legacy but still present.

build.title: Shopware Administration build and assets
build.description: Shopware admin build: Vite configuration, TypeScript, SCSS and styles, static assets, snippets and translations. Use when configuring the Shopware administration build or its assets.
build.intro: Vite replaced Webpack in 6.7. Snippets are the translation mechanism for admin strings.

meteor.title: Shopware Meteor design system
meteor.description: Shopware Meteor: getting started, mt-* components, composables, usage guidelines, the Meteor Admin SDK for apps. Use when the request names Meteor, an mt-* component or the Admin SDK.
meteor.intro: Meteor is the current component library — mt-* replaces the older sw-* components. The Admin SDK lets an app extend the admin without a plugin.
